payload.posture: Read Nehemiah 9:20–37 as evidence about the Kingdom, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states the assembly’s prayer remembers Sihon, Og, land, inheritance, disobedience, and foreign rule within a long recital. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Kingdom.
